d: Parphekt khasta aur rasili balushahi (Makhan Vada) khas tyauharon ki khas mithaee, ab ghar par aasani se banaen, parphekt mejarment ke sath, maide ko gunthne se lekar chashni banane aur use andar tak rasabhri aur paratdar rakhne ke sabhi tips sheyar kie hain. agar aapko paranprik mithaiyan pasand hain, to yah resipi aapke lie hai.
